headlines.summary_en: International crude oil opened lower on Monday, with Brent crude falling over 7% at one point, breaking below $90, while Nasdaq futures rose over 1%. US-Iran mutual strikes paused: Iran's military said Sunday that the US halted strikes for two consecutive nights and Iran suspended reciprocal strikes. Red Sea tensions escalated: Yemen's Houthi group attacked Saudi oil facilities in the Red Sea port twice in one day on Saturday, and Saudi Arabia responded with airstrikes. Former CSRC Vice Chairman Fang Xinghai is under investigation. Wang Yi met with Iranian Foreign Minister Araghchi, saying China continues to support mediation efforts by Pakistan and others to resume dialogue and negotiations as soon as possible and properly handle the Hormuz Strait issue. China's Ministry of Commerce added 14 EU entities to the export control list. The Ministry of Finance and State Administration of Taxation stated that property placed in offshore trusts by individual residents and trust gains must be subject to individual income tax. The Supreme People's Court and Supreme People's Procuratorate revised judicial interpretations to increase penalties for insider trading and leaking inside information.

headlines.title_en: Ultra-long-end bonds lead bond market rally; 30-year treasury futures hit a 2026 high.
headlines.summary_en: 【Super-long-end leads bond market rally; 30-year Treasury futures hit year high】Last week (July 20-24), the bond market broke out of its narrow range, with the super-long end rallying strongly. With the PBOC increasing MLF rollover and tax period disturbances fading, liquidity was broadly stable and loose. Loose expectations from the Politburo meeting at month-end and rumors of deposit rate cuts sparked buying sentiment, prompting insurance and other allocation desks to extend duration and buy super-long bonds under asset shortage pressure. Meanwhile, stock market pullbacks fueled safe-haven demand. Under multiple factors, the yield curve flattened.

headlines.title_en: NBS: Raw materials industry profits grew rapidly in the first half of the year.
headlines.summary_en: In the first half of the year, profits in raw materials manufacturing above designated size grew 71.7% year-on-year, driving total industrial profits up 8.8 percentage points. By sector, driven by strong demand for nonferrous products like copper and aluminum, nonferrous industry profits rose 99.4%, contributing 4.7 percentage points; with oil product price hikes, the petroleum processing sector turned profitable year-on-year, while chemical industry profits rose 67.8%.

headlines.title: 国家统计局：上半年人工智能与各领域加速融合，算力需求大幅增长，推动电子行业利润同比增长96.9%
headlines.summary: 电子相关行业利润高速增长。上半年，人工智能与各领域加速融合，算力需求大幅增长，推动电子行业利润同比增长96.9%，拉动全部规模以上工业企业利润增长8.5个百分点，是规模以上工业企业利润较快增长的重要支撑。其中，服务器、高性能工作站相关领域中，计算机整机制造、计算机外围设备制造行业利润分别增长689.3%、305.8%；电子器件制造领域中，集成电路制造、半导体分立器件制造行业利润增长2579.5%、31.2%；电子元件及电子专用材料制造领域中，电子专用材料制造、电子电路制造行业利润增长209.7%、26.9%。

headlines.title_en: NBS: AI accelerating integration across sectors in H1; surging computing power demand boosted electronics industry profits by 96.9% YoY.
headlines.summary_en: Electronics-related industry profits grew rapidly. In the first half, AI integration across sectors and surging computing demand drove electronics industry profits up 96.9% year-on-year, contributing 8.5 percentage points to total industrial profit growth, a key support. In the server and high-performance workstation segment, computer whole-machine manufacturing and peripheral equipment manufacturing profits surged 689.3% and 305.8%, respectively; in the electronic device manufacturing segment, integrated circuit manufacturing and semiconductor discrete device manufacturing profits rose 2579.5% and 31.2%; in the electronic component and specialized materials segment, electronic specialized materials manufacturing and electronic circuit manufacturing profits grew 209.7% and 26.9%.

headlines.title_en: Multiple Beijing Stock Exchange firms disclose buyback plans; special loan tools widen funding sources.
headlines.summary_en: Recently, share buybacks and shareholder increases at Beijing Stock Exchange-listed companies have notably heated up. As of the evening of July 24, over a dozen companies have disclosed buyback or major shareholder increase plans in July. From actual controllers and senior management to shareholders holding over 5%, various parties have disclosed increase intentions. From self-funds to special bank loans, funding sources continue to broaden.

headlines.title_en: Hong Kong stock movers: Xiaocaiyuan surges over 10% to a four-month high, with multiple major banks giving a 'buy' rating.
headlines.summary_en: Xiao Cai Yuan (0999.HK) surged over 10% intraday, hitting a high of 7.76 HKD, a new high since March 19. Major banks recently issued research reports bullish on the stock, giving 'buy' ratings. CITIC Securities maintained 'buy', noting steady store expansion—over 830 stores by end-June 2026 across 203 cities in 14 provinces; adjustment measures are optimizing operations for long-term healthy development, with takeout ratio optimization and membership system improvement. With a balanced volume-price mix and stable operations, its supply chain advantages and efficient store model are expected to sustain core positioning for steady expansion. Huayuan Securities also maintained 'buy'.
